def get_connected_regions(grid):
    """Find all connected regions of non-background pixels"""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Consider 0 as background, others as foreground
    visited = set()
    regions = []

                q = deque([(r,c)])
                visited.add((r,c))
                
                while q:

                regions.append(region)
    
    return regions
